items.name: Beeplus
items.challenge: SlabPixel came with a clear vision: a bold, colorful delivery app website with that playful Dribbble energy. The catch was a tight timeline, with no room to compromise on quality.
items.approach: I started from their reference and broke down its typography, colors, and layout to capture what made it feel alive. Four days later, the full landing page was done, responsive version included.

items.name: Mercedes F1
items.challenge: The existing website was static, which felt at odds with a team built on speed. The goal was to turn it into a website that moves, with the F1 car itself leading the story.
items.approach: We made the car and its parts the main key visual and carried them through every section. Hover, scroll, and every interaction set those parts in motion, so the website finally moves at the pace of the team behind it.

items.name: Enso
items.challenge: Enso wanted to leave their glowing, dark mode crypto look behind for something fresh and grounded in traditional finance. A complete change of direction, not just a refresh.

items.name: Sync
items.challenge: Sync needed a product page template they could reuse again and again, without it ever looking like a template or feeling basic.
items.approach: I blended the structure of a template with the rhythm of editorial design. Aesthetic imagery and a vibrant gradient do the rest, giving every page enough personality to stand on its own.

items.name: Routeonefi
items.challenge: Routeonefi wanted a website that felt illustrative while keeping a clean crypto feel, and there were no brand guidelines to lean on.
items.approach: I gave every section a simple, semi 3D UI illustration, paired with subtle brand colors and a clean, tidy typeface. Enough character to feel illustrative, restrained enough to never feel overwhelming or cheap.

items.name: Arcania
items.challenge: Arcania is about interior design, so the website had to feel designed like a room: its layout, its type, even the way it responds to you.
items.approach: We borrowed the ruler as our grid. Every section is built on visible guide lines and shares the same view height, so scrolling through the website feels like walking through rooms drawn to scale.

items.name: Onestable
items.challenge: Four days to design and build the whole website in Framer, and it still had to feel polished, not rushed.
items.approach: The client had fallen for one of my explorations and wanted their website to feel just like it. So I used that exploration as the foundation and shaped it around their existing branding.

items.name: Recruitpilot
items.challenge: Recruitpilot wanted a SaaS look with a glow effect, but without pulling attention away from the platform's features. All in just three days.
items.approach: I kept the typography simple and saved the circular glow for the hero and the call to action. Everywhere else, the platform's own interface became the visual, so the product does the talking.

items.name: Wegonorth
items.challenge: Wegonorth wanted a website that tells their story through a symbol of their own, one that carries their motto: moving forward.
items.approach: A compass became the key visual. Its movement runs through the entire website, in every scroll animation and hover, always pointing the way forward.

items.name: Anywear
items.challenge: Anywear's mobile app needed a single landing page that brings three worlds together as one concept: SaaS, mobile app, and editorial layout.
items.approach: The layout follows editorial principles with generous white space, giving the fashion room to breathe. UI elements bring in the tech side to show off the app's features, so style and product sit naturally on the same page.

items.name: Lexur
items.challenge: Lexur wanted the dark, glowing crypto look without it ever feeling overwhelming: glow and simplicity in balance, with only two days to make it happen.
items.approach: I used simple illustrations for the core sections and saved the vibrant glow for where it matters most, the hero and the call to action. A simple typeface keeps everything else clean.
